title: Make It Real
summary: Listen to EXL podcast 'Make It Real' featuring expert discussions and insights on enterprise AI adoption, innovation and emerging technology trends.
body_markdown:
Artificial intelligence ### Episode 9: How agentic AI transforms insurance with Ronak Doshi and Sarat Varanasi October 15, 2026

Ronak and Sarat explore how agentic AI helps organizations modernize legacy systems, unlock hidden insights, and build the next generation of operations. Together, they discuss why AI creates the most value when companies rethink processes, workflows, and operating models rather than simply adding technology to existing ways of working.

Duration: 24:02 mins Shirley Macbeth and Ronak Doshi and Sarat Varanasi [View episode](https://www.exlservice.com/insights/make-it-real-exl-podcasts/episode-9-how-agentic-ai-transforms-insurance-with-ronak-doshi-and-sarat-varanasi) Artificial intelligence ### Episode 8: Why AI agents need better operating models to scale with Sumit Taneja October 1, 2026

Sumit discuss why simply adding AI to existing processes can limit transformation, and how a combination of domain expertise and context help AI agents deliver better outcomes. He also covers why organizations need new approaches to governance, measurement, and assurance.

Duration: 26:55 mins Shirley Macbeth and Sumit Taneja [View episode](https://www.exlservice.com/insights/make-it-real-exl-podcasts/episode-8-why-ai-agents-need-better-operating-models-to-scale-with-sumit-taneja) Artificial intelligence ### Episode 7: The data problem holding back healthcare AI with Arun Rangamani September 18, 2026

Arun discusses why getting your data right is the first step in transformation, unlocking new insights by combining structured and unstructured healthcare data, and the importance of context and domain expertise.

Duration: 22:59 mins Shirley Macbeth and Arun Rangamani [View episode](https://www.exlservice.com/insights/make-it-real-exl-podcasts/episode-7-the-data-problem-holding-back-healthcare-ai-with-arun-rangamani) Artificial intelligence ### Episode 6: Using AI to protect healthcare systems with Kurt Spear July 16, 2026

Kurt offers insights into how AI is changing the nature of healthcare fraud, and how to solve new challenges by successfully combining human judgment with technology.
